tools.description:
Delegate a focused task to an isolated Proteus agent profile and return its summary.
The subagent starts with a FRESH context, so include all necessary background in the prompt; parent history is not passed.
Reuse task_id from a previous task result to continue that subagent with its accumulated context.
Choose the role that best matches the delegated work and keep the prompt specific.
Do the work yourself when it needs your accumulated context, close supervision, or tight iteration with the user.
Several task calls issued in one reply run concurrently when every requested role is parallel-safe or worktree-isolated (marked in the role list); use that for independent research or independent isolated changes. Any other combination runs sequentially.

tools.description: Send a follow-up to one session-owned collaboration agent. Running agents receive it at the nearest model/tool boundary; an idle terminal agent starts a resumable turn with the same logical path and thread id.
tools.name: followup_task

tools.description: Request cancellation of one session-owned collaboration agent. Its bounded terminal payload is queued for wait_agent; list_agents retains durable terminal status.
tools.name: interrupt_agent

tools.description: List experimental Proteus collaboration agents owned by the current session.
tools.name: list_agents

tools.description: Queue a message for one running session-owned collaboration agent. Delivery occurs at the nearest model/tool boundary and does not start an idle turn; use followup_task for an idle agent.
tools.name: send_message

tools.description: Start one experimental Proteus collaboration agent. Returns a session-owned canonical /root/<task_name> handle immediately.

task_name.description: Unique one-segment name within this session.
